summary: The PR correctly implements the required `merge_windows` and `is_in_blackout` functions, adhering to the half-open interval logic and preserving legacy behavior. All provided tests pass.
key_findings: merge_windows correctly handles adjacent intervals (e.g., [10,20) and [20,30) merge to [10,30)).
is_in_blackout correctly implements half-open logic (start <= ts < end).
Legacy function interval_duration remains unchanged and passing.
Input validation in merge_windows filters out invalid intervals (e <= s) before processing.
